<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"><style>/* ==========================================================================
   DIPLOMAT MANAGEMENT SERVICES (DMS BAHRAIN)
   Modern Minimalist Design System
   Pure White Base (#FFFFFF) + Royal Emerald Green (#00A859 / #007A3E)
   Typography: Apple 'SF Pro Display' & 'SF Pro Text'
   ========================================================================== */

@import url('https://fonts.cdnfonts.com/css/sf-pro-display');

:root {
  /* Font Family - Apple SF Pro Stack */
  --font-main: 'SF Pro Display', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'SF Pro', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;

  /* Color Palette */
  --bg-pure: #ffffff;
  --bg-subtle: #f8fafc;
  --bg-card: #ffffff;
  --bg-card-hover: #f0fdf4;
  --bg-pill-header: #0f172a;
  
  /* Brand Green Shades */
  --primary-green: #00A859;
  --primary-green-dark: #007A3E;
  --primary-green-deep: #004D25;
  --primary-green-light: #e8f9ee;
  --primary-green-glow: rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.16);
  --primary-green-border: rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.22);

  /* Neutrals */
  --text-dark: #090e17;
  --text-muted: #475569;
  --text-subtle: #94a3b8;
  --text-white: #ffffff;
  --border-light: #e2e8f0;
  --border-subtle: #f1f5f9;

  /* Elevation Shadows */
  --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
  --shadow-md: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
  --shadow-lg: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  --shadow-green: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.2);

  /* Layout & Transitions */
  --container-max: 1240px;
  --radius-full: 9999px;
  --radius-xl: 28px;
  --radius-lg: 20px;
  --radius-md: 14px;
  --radius-sm: 8px;
  --transition: all 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

/* Reset & Base */
*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  font-family: var(--font-main);
  color: var(--text-dark);
  background-color: var(--bg-pure);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

body {
  background-color: var(--bg-pure);
  overflow-x: hidden;
  line-height: 1.6;
  font-family: var(--font-main);
}

img {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
}

a {
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

button, input, select, textarea {
  font-family: var(--font-main);
}

.container {
  max-width: var(--container-max);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 24px;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   DYNAMIC NAVBAR: Full-Width at Top -> Smooth Floating Capsule on Scroll
   ========================================================================== */
.header-wrapper {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 100%;
  z-index: 1000;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: all 0.38s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

/* Top Default State: Full-Width Clean Header */
.capsule-nav {
  pointer-events: auto;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  height: 76px;
  padding: 0 48px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
  border-radius: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
  transition: all 0.38s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

/* Scrolled State: Morphs into Compact Floating Capsule with Rounded Pill */
.header-wrapper.is-scrolled {
  top: 18px;
  padding: 0 16px;
}

.header-wrapper.is-scrolled .capsule-nav {
  max-width: 1120px;
  height: 56px;
  padding: 8px 18px 8px 24px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}

.capsule-nav.scrolled {
  border-color: rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.3);
}

.nav-brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}

.nav-brand-img {
  height: 38px;
  width: auto;
}

.nav-links {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 22px;
  list-style: none;
}

/* Nav links in Top Full-Width State (White Background) */
.nav-links a {
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #1e293b;
  position: relative;
  transition: var(--transition);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

.nav-links a:hover,
.nav-links a.active {
  color: var(--primary-green-dark);
}

.nav-links a::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -4px;
  left: 0;
  width: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--primary-green);
  border-radius: 2px;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.nav-links a:hover::after,
.nav-links a.active::after {
  width: 100%;
}

/* Nav links in Scrolled Capsule State (Dark Background) */
.header-wrapper.is-scrolled .nav-links a {
  color: #cbd5e1;
}

.header-wrapper.is-scrolled .nav-links a:hover,
.header-wrapper.is-scrolled .nav-links a.active {
  color: #ffffff;
}

/* Nav Item Dropdown */
.nav-dropdown {
  position: relative;
}

.nav-dropdown-menu {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 14px);
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(10px);
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.98);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.3);
  border-radius: 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  padding: 16px 20px;
  width: 320px;
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  z-index: 1050;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: all 0.22s ease-in-out;
}

.nav-dropdown:hover .nav-dropdown-menu {
  display: flex;
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
}

.nav-dropdown-menu a {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #e2e8f0;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  transition: var(--transition);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.nav-dropdown-menu a::after {
  display: none;
}

.nav-dropdown-menu a:hover {
  background: rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.15);
  color: #86efac;
  transform: translateX(3px);
}

.nav-dropdown-menu .drop-num {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--primary-green);
  width: 20px;
}

.nav-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}

.btn-contact-pill {
  background: #0f172a;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 10px 24px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.btn-contact-pill:hover {
  background: var(--primary-green);
  color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.4);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.header-wrapper.is-scrolled .btn-contact-pill {
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #0f172a;
}

.header-wrapper.is-scrolled .btn-contact-pill:hover {
  background: var(--primary-green);
  color: #ffffff;
}

.menu-toggle,
.mobile-menu-toggle {
  display: none;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  transition: var(--transition);
  z-index: 1002;
}

.mobile-menu-toggle:hover,
.mobile-menu-toggle:focus {
  background: rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.2);
  border-color: rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.5);
}

.mobile-menu-toggle .hamburger-bar {
  display: block;
  width: 20px;
  height: 2px;
  background-color: #0f172a;
  border-radius: 2px;
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.header-wrapper.is-scrolled .mobile-menu-toggle {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
}

.header-wrapper.is-scrolled .mobile-menu-toggle .hamburger-bar {
  background-color: #ffffff;
}

/* Active hamburger turns into 'X' */
.mobile-menu-toggle.is-active .hamburger-bar:nth-child(1) {
  transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg);
  background-color: var(--primary-green);
}

.mobile-menu-toggle.is-active .hamburger-bar:nth-child(2) {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scaleX(0);
}

.mobile-menu-toggle.is-active .hamburger-bar:nth-child(3) {
  transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg);
  background-color: var(--primary-green);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   MOBILE DRAWER OVERLAY & NAVIGATION
   ========================================================================== */
.mobile-drawer-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.82);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  z-index: 99999;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease, visibility 0.3s ease;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.mobile-drawer-overlay.is-open {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.mobile-drawer-content {
  background: #0b1324;
  border-left: 1px solid rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.3);
  box-shadow: -15px 0 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  width: 86%;
  max-width: 360px;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 24px 20px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  transform: translateX(100%);
  transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.mobile-drawer-overlay.is-open .mobile-drawer-content {
  transform: translateX(0);
}

.mobile-drawer-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding-bottom: 18px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.mobile-drawer-logo {
  height: 26px;
  width: auto;
}

.mobile-drawer-close {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  color: #cbd5e1;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.mobile-drawer-close:hover {
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2);
  color: #ef4444;
  border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
}

.mobile-drawer-nav {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.mobile-nav-links {
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.mobile-nav-link {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f1f5f9;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.mobile-nav-link:hover,
.mobile-nav-link.active {
  background: rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.15);
  color: #86efac;
}

.mobile-dropdown-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.mobile-dropdown-trigger {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f1f5f9;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.mobile-dropdown-trigger:hover {
  background: rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.15);
  color: #86efac;
}

.mobile-dropdown-trigger .chevron-icon {
  transition: transform 0.25s ease;
}

.mobile-dropdown-item.is-expanded .chevron-icon {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.mobile-dropdown-sublist {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 6px 0 6px 12px;
  margin-left: 8px;
  border-left: 2px solid rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.3);
}

.mobile-dropdown-item.is-expanded .mobile-dropdown-sublist {
  display: flex;
}

.mobile-dropdown-sublist a {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #cbd5e1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.mobile-dropdown-sublist a .num {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--primary-green);
  width: 18px;
}

.mobile-dropdown-sublist a:hover {
  background: rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.15);
  color: #86efac;
}

.mobile-drawer-footer {
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.btn-mobile-consult {
  background: var(--primary-green);
  color: #ffffff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  padding: 13px 20px;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.35);
  transition: var(--transition);
  width: 100%;
}

.btn-mobile-consult:hover {
  background: var(--primary-green-dark);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.mobile-quick-contacts {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.mobile-contact-pill {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  color: #e2e8f0;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.mobile-contact-pill.whatsapp {
  background: rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.15);
  border-color: rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.3);
  color: #86efac;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   GRAND FULL-WIDTH HERO SLIDER (White Background - Lulu Exchange Inspired)
   ========================================================================== */
.hero-grand-section {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 94vh;
  background: #ffffff;
  padding-top: 105px;
  padding-bottom: 25px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero-grand-slides-container {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.hero-grand-slide {
  display: none;
  width: 100%;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(16px);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.hero-grand-slide.is-active {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;
  pointer-events: auto;
  animation: heroGrandFadeIn 0.48s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
}

@keyframes heroGrandFadeIn {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(18px);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}

.hero-grand-slide-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.18fr 0.92fr;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 55px;
  width: 100%;
  padding-top: 20px;
  padding-bottom: 20px;
}

/* Left Content Column */
.hero-grand-content {
  max-width: 680px;
}

.hero-slide-eyebrow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.eyebrow-pill-badge {
  background: var(--primary-green-light);
  color: var(--primary-green-dark);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.25);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.eyebrow-authority-tag {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.hero-grand-title {
  font-size: 52px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.12;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  color: #090e17;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.title-highlight-green {
  color: var(--primary-green);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-green) 0%, #007A3E 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}

.hero-grand-desc {
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: #475569;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
  max-width: 620px;
}

.hero-grand-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}

.btn-hero-primary {
  background: var(--primary-green);
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 14px 28px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.35);
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.btn-hero-primary:hover {
  background: var(--primary-green-dark);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0, 168, 89, 0.45);
}

.btn-hero-secondary {
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #0f172a;
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 14px 26px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.btn-hero-secondary:hover {
  background: #f8fafc;
  border-color: #94a3b8;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.hero-trust-metrics {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  padding-top: 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
}

.metric-pill {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.metric-pill strong {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #090e17;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.metric-pill span {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #64748b;
}

.metric-divider {
  width: 1px;
  height: 32px;
  background: #e2e8f0;
}

/* Right Visual Image Showcase */
.hero-grand-visual {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
}

.visual-card-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 520px;
}

.visual-img-frame {
  width: 100%;
  height: 400px;
  border-radius: 26px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 25px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12), 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  background: #f8fafc;
  position: relative;
}

.hero-visual-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform 0.8s ease;
}

.hero-grand-slide.is-active .hero-visual-img {
  transform: scale(1.02);
}

/* Floating Image Badges */
.visual-badge-overlay.top-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: 18px;
  left: 18px;
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  color: #ffffff;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}

.visual-badge-overlay.top-badge .badge-dot {
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #22c55e;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px #22c55e;
}

.visual-badge-overlay.bottom-card {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -16px;
  right: 18px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 13px 18px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  max-width: 330px;
}

.badge-icon-circle {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #f0fdf4;
  color: var(--primary-green-dark);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.badge-info h6 {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #0f172a;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.badge-info p {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #64748b;
  margin: 0;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   LULU EXCHANGE STYLE SLIDER CONTROLS BAR
